parameters.text:
Write a 1,500-word blog post targeting the primary keyword: "{{ $('Form Submission').item.json['Primary Keyword (Focus Keyword)'] }}".

**RESEARCH DATA**: {{ $json.message.content }}
**SECONDARY KEYWORDS**: {{ $('Form Submission').item.json['Secondary Keywords'] }}

**MANDATORY STRUCTURE:**
1. H1 Title with primary keyword
2. Opening sentence starting with Focus Keyword
3. Estimated reading time (7-8 minutes)
4. TL;DR section with 5-7 bullet points
5. Meta description as HTML comment (150-160 chars)
6. Featured snippet answer (40-60 words)
7. Table of contents with anchor links
8. 6+ H2/H3 headings with natural keyword usage
9. Q&A blocks ("What is...?", "How does...?")
10. Comparison tables or pros/cons lists
11. 2 use case examples with metrics
12. Key takeaways section (3-5 bullets)
13. Summary box (4-6 bullet points)
14. Conclusion + CTA to https://contextqa.com

**SEO REQUIREMENTS:**
- Focus keyword appears 5+ times and in 3+ H2 headings
- Bold the Focus Keyword 2-3 times
- Include secondary keywords: flakiness, rework, slowness, locator maintain, error handling
- Add 2-3 external DoFollow links
- Include JSON-LD schema for Article and FAQ
- 1,500 words exactly

Output the complete blog post content only.
